text: {"assertions":["A message redelivery bug was discovered in worker/queue/consumer.py affecting background job processing.","The bug could be reproduced by killing the worker mid-batch and restarting it.","The symptom was that the same message ID was being handled more than once after client retry.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix involved removing the listener on teardown and adding an assertion test in PR #5373 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1.","After the fix, the flaky test failure rate decreased from 29 per 100 runs to zero.","The issue is covered by tests in tests/worker/test_consumer.py.","The project stack is Python."]}
